style.backgroundSystem: seamless pearl white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust screens, soft sakura pink #FAD8D4 panels for benefit, scene, variant and CTA screens, one deep rose #E4466E close panel

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent sweet princess kidswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pearl white #FFFFFF, sakura pink #FAD8D4, deep rose accent #E4466E and warm charcoal text #4A4142; bright soft warm studio lighting with a front-left key and gentle contact shadows; rounded geometric sans-serif; delicate thin-line doodle icons in rose only; clean high-key garment photography mixed with minimal pastel infographic panels; stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle and consistent scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle, consistent scale and centering across the set
